Meeting Minutes: 
The president  Sri Dr N Sudhakar Reddy,  welcomed all the IIC council members for the Second 
Council Meeting. IIC President given a brief overview of activities under IIC, MIC, Celebration Day 
and Self-driven activities to be organized under Quarter-2. 
Agenda: 
 
  l. IIC Calendar Activity 
 2. MIC Driven Activity 
 3. Self-Driven Activity 
 4. Celebration Day Activities 
 5. Any other with permission of President 
 
Agenda Point 1: IIC discussed to prepare Calendar Activities for the Quarter 2.  
Resolution: Prepared Calendar Activities for the Quarter 2  and approved by IIC President and other 
Members.   
Agenda Point 2: IIC Council discussed to prepare MIC Calendar Activities for the Quarter 2.  
Resolution: Prepared MIC Calendar Activities for the Quarter 2  and approved by IIC President and 
IIC Members.  
Agenda Point 3: IIC Council discussed to prepare Self Driven Activities for the Quarter 2.  
Resolution: Prepared Self Driven Activities for the Quarter 2 and it was approved by IIC President 
and IIC Members.
